title: Rupert Zaragoza opens 'three-peat' bid at Marapara with a 68

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The ‘three-peat’-seeking Rupert Zaragosa fired a two-under-par 68 on Monday to trail joint leaders Art Arbole and Jonel Ababa by three shots after the first round of the P2.5 million ICTSI Negros Occidental Classic over the tree-lined layout formerly known as Marapara. The diminutive Davao native had four birdies and dropped his second shot on the par-4 17th for a 34-34 card that still kept him well within range of doing something that no one in the PGT has ever achieved: win a leg for three straight years.
